'''Alvon Zamar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
When [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Layek Davos]] was eliminated by [[Cipher Nine]] on Hoth for his corruption and apparent betrayal of the Sith Empire, it was up to Moff Zamar to find a replacement to lead [[Imperial Search and Recovery]] on short notice. Despite having put the Empire's readiness at risk, Zamar commended the Agents handling of the situation, though preferring to have been consulted first.<ref name="Zamar Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|Regarding the Death of Admiral Davos|Moff Zamar}}</ref>

During the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], Alvon Zamar was ordered to survey the occupation by the [[Dark Council]]. He was aided by Cipher Nine who planted several landing beacons across [[Labor Valley]] in order to force Zamar's skyhopper to land, allowing the agent to rescue the Moff from the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] who were attacking his downed ship. However, he was killed by Cipher Nine during the battle.<ref name="SWTOR" />
